The build failure is caused by a **git commit author name validation error**.

## Root Cause

The `commit_gitlint` check failed with this error:
```
UC4 Author user has too few words; likely user id instead of legal name?: "vinothkumars"
```

The gitlint tool detected that your commit author is set to `"vinothkumars"` (a username) instead of a proper legal name with at least two words (like "Vinoth Kumar Shanmugavel").

## Solution

Update your git configuration to use your full name:

```bash
git config --global user.name "Vinoth Kumar Shanmugavel"
```

Then amend your commit to update the author:

```bash
git commit --amend --reset-author --no-edit
git push origin HEAD:refs/for/master
```

This will update the commit with the proper author name and satisfy the gitlint UC4 rule. All other code quality checks (clang-format, prettier, shellcheck, etc.) passed successfully.

_**User (2026-04-20 12:05:11Z)**_

metadata: Serve XML schemas dynamically to reduce RAM usage

Replace individual static routes for Redfish XML schema files with a
single dynamic route handler. This significantly reduces bmcweb's
memory footprint by eliminating hundreds of route registrations.

Changes:
- metadata.hpp: Added handleSchemaGet() to serve schema files from
  /redfish/v1/schema/<filename> with proper input validation
- webassets.hpp: Skip static registration of schema directories
  (redfish/v1/schema and redfish/v1/JsonSchemas) as these are now
  handled by dedicated dynamic routes
- authentication.hpp: Allow public access to schema files per
  Redfish specification requirements

The /redfish/v1/$metadata endpoint continues to reference schema
URIs and functions correctly.

Tested:
- Valid schema requests work correctly
- Invalid requests return proper 404 responses
- Passed DMTF Redfish Service Validator
- /redfish/v1/$metadata generates complete metadata document

Performance:
- Measured 0.4 MB reduction in process RSS (1.6MB → 1.2MB)
- Approximately 17% memory footprint improvement
- Eliminated ~200 static route registrations

Change-Id: I01bef0b90899deda9825bc2e94b1b498f08374fe
Signed-off-by: vinothkumars <vinothkumars@ami.com>
Signed-off-by: Vinoth Kumar Shanmugavel <vinothkumars@ami.com>

```
commit 85420c7db38e607ab2495393d26b2e03c5e6c3ef (HEAD -> bmcweb_ram_memory_optimization)
Author: Vinoth Kumar Shanmugavel <vinothkumars@ami.com>
Commit: Vinoth Kumar Shanmugavel <vinothkumars@ami.com>

    metadata: Serve XML schemas dynamically to reduce RAM usage
    
    Replace individual static routes for Redfish XML schema files with a
    single dynamic route handler. This significantly reduces bmcweb's
    memory footprint by eliminating hundreds of route registrations.
    
    Changes:
    - metadata.hpp: Added handleSchemaGet() to serve schema files from
      /redfish/v1/schema/<filename> with proper input validation
    - webassets.hpp: Skip static registration of schema directories
      (redfish/v1/schema and redfish/v1/JsonSchemas) as these are now
      handled by dedicated dynamic routes
    - authentication.hpp: Allow public access to schema files per
      Redfish specification requirements
    
    The /redfish/v1/$metadata endpoint continues to reference schema
    URIs and functions correctly.
    
    Tested:
    - Valid schema requests work correctly
    - Invalid requests return proper 404 responses
    - Passed DMTF Redfish Service Validator
    - /redfish/v1/$metadata generates complete metadata document
    
    Performance:
    - Measured 0.4 MB reduction in process RSS (1.6MB → 1.2MB)
    - Approximately 17% memory footprint improvement
    - Eliminated ~200 static route registrations
    
    Change-Id: I01bef0b90899deda9825bc2e94b1b498f08374fe
    Signed-off-by: vinothkumars <vinothkumars@ami.com>
    Signed-off-by: Vinoth Kumar Shanmugavel <vinothkumars@ami.com>
```

_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-4.5)**_

The build is failing due to a **clang-tidy code style violation**, not related to the git author name anymore.

## Error Details

The clang-tidy checker found a style issue in [redfish-core/lib/metadata.hpp](redfish-core/lib/metadata.hpp#L156):

```
error: do not use 'else' after 'return' [readability-else-after-return]
```

## The Problem

In your code, you have:
```cpp
if (/* condition */)
{
    messages::resourceNotFound(asyncResp->res, "schemaFile", schema);
    return;
}
else if (ec != crow::OpenCode::Success)  // ← Unnecessary 'else'
{
    // ...
}
```

Since the first `if` block has a `return`, the `else` is redundant.

## Solution

Change line 156 in [redfish-core/lib/metadata.hpp](redfish-core/lib/metadata.hpp#L156) from:
```cpp
else if (ec != crow::OpenCode::Success)
```

to:
```cpp
if (ec != crow::OpenCode::Success)
```

The Jenkins log shows this diff was auto-generated by clang-tidy:
```diff
-    else if (ec != crow::OpenCode::Success)
+    if (ec != crow::OpenCode::Success)
```

Apply this change, commit with `--amend`, and push again to Gerrit.
